make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; the part reports 61 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette. `mcd room --only "tobacco barn"` says OK (walk reaches every lane cell, light min 11, 0 dark, FIT OK).
Room view rendered (room.png, from above; no eye view for a 4-wide room). Full-build render and the `mcd check` warnings in my cells (east pole ends) are not resolved; the openings part must add the x68 vent trapdoors.
left: Full-build render (`mcd render build.nbt --front n --tiles tiles`) not run in the time budget; the barn was checked only through the room tool and room.png.
Firebox mouth (65,1,15) and its campfire belong to the chimneys part; the room is lit through that mouth, so re-measure the light once the chimney and the shell's north wall are in.

`mcd check` flags the east tier-pole ends (67,5/7/9,14) as ORPHAN: they touch only the x68 wall, which has no vent trapdoor yet. They should read as attached once the openings part builds the vent slots at x68 z14 y3..9.
The room tool counts 8 cells at y10 (x64..67, z10/z12) as unreachable floor. Those are above the 1-high floor and are not walkable space; the verdict still says OK, so I left them alone.
The ladder foot (64,1,14) and the ladder column are locked by the hearths part; I did not touch them.
